purpose: Candidate enemy contracts for expanding animal species and combat role variety without changing active route balance.
globalArtRules: Single readable enemy character per generated image.
Animal anatomy stays natural and non-humanoid.
Stylish present-day urban clothing adapts to the animal body and does not impair movement or alter anatomy.
No readable text, logos, gang uniforms, magic effects, sci-fi armor, human hands, human arms, human posture, or fantasy costume.
defaultArtPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, guarding, coiled, or ready to spring while staying readable; full body visible with natural anatomy, standing or resting on an implied ground line with weight supported by species-appropriate feet, paws, claws, talons, body coil, or shell; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

reserveEnemies.name: Rooftop Raccoon
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Item disruption and evasive scavenger pressure.
reserveEnemies.description: A nimble rooftop scavenger that rifles through route gear and slips behind HVAC cover before the flock can pin it down.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Natural raccoon in a cropped utility vest, reflective strap harness, small tool sling, and flexible paw wraps on rain-dark tar paper beside vents and wire bundles.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Low masked mammal with ringed tail, hunched shoulders, quick paws, and compact scavenger stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low and ready on all fours with head aligned to the body angle, tail free for balance, and clothing clear of shoulders and hips.
moveKit: Snatch: adds a discard Snag if ignored.
Trashcan Feint: light damage plus Winded.

reserveEnemies.name: Canal Otter
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Uses waterline movement and backline pressure.
reserveEnemies.description: A slick canal runner that slides through wet lanes and appears where the flock thought the crossing was safe.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Streamlined otter in a fitted waterproof shell, clipped pouch harness, and close neck scarf on wet dock planks near lock water and rope coils.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Long low body, tapered head, thick tail, and slippery side-on movement read.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched low on natural paws with long tail visible and rainwear tight to the body.
moveKit: Rear Splash: damage if the flock has no Cover.

reserveEnemies.name: Alley Cat
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Stealth burst that rewards early targeting.
reserveEnemies.description: A patient alley hunter that waits under market shadow, then bursts through a gap in the formation.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Lean city cat in a narrow streetwear collar, asymmetrical back panel, soft ankle wraps, and small side pouch among alley crates and fire escapes.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Sleek crouched feline with arched back, sharp ears, long tail, and spring-loaded legs.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched on all fours with tail free, natural shoulders, and no sleeves or human jacket shape.
moveKit: Stalk: next attack bonus if not hit.

reserveEnemies.name: Pigeon Enforcer
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Sturdy group pressure that fits multi-enemy encounters.
reserveEnemies.description: A heavy city pigeon that crowds the perch and forces the flock to spend Cover instead of setting up.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Stocky pigeon in a bomber-style chest wrap, wing-safe shoulder markings, concrete-gray talon bands, and subtle chain clips on a ledge.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Round broad chest, tucked head, short legs, and stubborn planted bird stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, planted on natural feet with folded wings unobstructed and jacket panels following the chest mass.

reserveEnemies.name: Crow Saboteur
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Objective disruption, Snags, and utility denial.
reserveEnemies.description: A wire-smart crow that clips loose lines and leaves route systems tangled without needing any magic to cause trouble.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Glossy crow in a black courier harness, bright zipper pulls, wire-tool charms, and talon bands near breaker boxes and antenna cable.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Medium corvid with long beak, folded wing mass, dangling wire loops, and tilted problem-solver posture.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, bird grounded on talons with tool props clipped to harness, never held by invented hands.
moveKit: Wire Peck: damage plus next attack bonus.

reserveEnemies.name: Heron Spearstepper
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Long-reach telegraphs and lane control.
reserveEnemies.description: A still canal hunter that threatens from the edge of the water with patient, precise reach.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Tall heron in a tailored waterproof sash, pinned-close scarf, reflective leg bands, and small dock satchel beside a canal rail.

reserveEnemies.silhouette: Broad gull with cocked head, lifted beak, and opportunistic sideways stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded with wings folded and shell wrap not binding flight.

reserveEnemies.description: A representative signal cicada whose rattling wing buzz scrambles tells in dense spire weather.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Single large cicada enemy in tiny signal-safe strap accents and reflective tags on a utility box, with natural transparent wings unobstructed.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Small insect with broad wings, stout body, round eyes, and vibrating-ready posture.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, one readable cicada grounded or perched low, not a cluster or cloud.

reserveEnemies.name: Hedgehog Curb-Crosser
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Small target that controls sidewalk lanes.
reserveEnemies.description: A compact curb defender that is hard to dislodge and slows the flock in tight concrete lanes.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Hedgehog in a tiny roadworker harness, reflective trim, and paw wraps that leave spines and legs free near curb drains.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Very low oval body with spines, small face, and stubborn little feet.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low and grounded with natural spines visible and no bulky clothing.

reserveEnemies.name: Kingfisher Snapdiver
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Perch-to-water burst timing.
reserveEnemies.description: A sharp canal kingfisher that waits above the waterline and strikes exactly when the flock drifts.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Belted kingfisher in a close rain collar, tiny waterproof side pouch, and talon bands beside low canal posts and rippled water.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Compact crested bird with large head, dagger beak, short tail, and taut crouch.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons with wings folded and beak aligned to the body angle.

reserveEnemies.name: Monitor Lizard Strider
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Slow pursuit with bite feints and tail sweeps.
reserveEnemies.description: A confident canal strider that advances slowly, forcing the flock to decide when to spend burst damage.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Monitor lizard in a flexible utility harness, rain-slick back straps, and tiny cargo pouch with tail, legs, and belly fully free.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Long muscular reptile with heavy tail, low legs, pointed head, and stalking line.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low natural quadruped posture with tail clear and straps following the torso.

reserveEnemies.name: Snapping Turtle Dock Boss
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Bridge and dock chokepoint boss with dangerous bite windows.
reserveEnemies.description: A massive old dock turtle that owns the bridge crossing and turns every approach into a risk calculation.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Large snapping turtle with shell-safe cargo net, weathered dock tags, and small waterproof pouches, natural head and tail unobstructed.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Huge low shell, thick neck, heavy beak, long tail, and immovable dock-boss base.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, resting heavy on natural legs with shell shape unchanged by accessories.
moveKit: Dock Lock: add Snag plus Winded.

reserveEnemies.name: Macaque Market Raider
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Uses loose market objects while staying animal-bodied.
reserveEnemies.description: A quick market raider that scatters fruit, cans, and bags from the environment without becoming a humanoid fighter.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Macaque in a fitted back harness, small pouch straps, and flexible wraps; natural primate limbs only, knuckle-supported posture, no human gestures or clothing silhouette.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Compact primate with long tail, crouched body, natural hands treated as animal paws, and quick market-raider stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched low on natural limbs with no upright human posture and no hand-held weapon pose.
moveKit: Pilfer: gain Cover if not hit.

reserveEnemies.name: Peacock Intimidator
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Display buffs and sightline obscuring without magic.
reserveEnemies.description: A high-status peacock that uses plumage, posture, and spectacle to make nearby threats look bigger.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Peacock in a minimalist collar, body-safe decorative clips, and talon bands, with natural train fully visible and unaltered.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Large bird with dramatic fan train, small head crest, and proud natural stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on natural feet with display feathers doing the intimidation, not clothing bulk.

reserveEnemies.name: Jackrabbit Sprinter
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Burst movement that punishes camping.
reserveEnemies.description: A long-legged sprinter that crosses dangerous ground in bursts and refuses to stay where expected.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Jackrabbit in a lightweight runner harness, flexible leg bands, tiny side pouch, and no footwear or leg-restricting clothing on cracked concrete.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Tall-eared rabbit with long back legs, lean body, and explosive crouch.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched on natural paws with hind legs free and ears readable.
moveKit: Overrun: nextAttackBonus if flock has no Cover.

reserveEnemies.name: Weasel Cutpurse
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Tags the flock with snagged straps or stolen gear effects.
reserveEnemies.description: A narrow cutpurse that clips loose straps, tangles route gear, and vanishes into the next drain gap.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Weasel in a slim dark vest, tiny clip pouch, and close paw wraps near alley straps and drain covers.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Long skinny mammal with pointed muzzle, tiny paws, and fast low profile.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, low on natural paws with clothing flush to the body.

reserveEnemies.name: Duckweed Frog
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Hidden canal greenery ambush.
reserveEnemies.description: A broad frog that disappears in duckweed until the flock steps too close to the waterline.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Bullfrog in a tiny green waterproof harness with flexible leg bands, duckweed bits around but not covering anatomy, beside canal stones.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Wide squat amphibian with huge mouth, strong legs, and low hidden posture.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched naturally with legs free and no cloak-like clothing.

reserveEnemies.name: Vulture Cleanup Crew
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Gets stronger around defeated units and low-health targets.
reserveEnemies.description: A patient high-roost scavenger that waits for weakness and makes every late fight feel dangerous.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Turkey vulture in worn roost mantle, utility harness, talon bands, and subtle salvage tags; natural bare head and wings unobstructed.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Large hunched scavenger bird with bare head, broad wings, and watchful droop.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons with mantle following folded wings rather than making human shoulders.

reserveEnemies.name: Woodpecker Riveter
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Repeated pecks weaken Cover and fortified objectives.
reserveEnemies.description: A precise riveter that pecks loose brackets, panels, and cover points until defenses give way.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Pileated woodpecker in a cropped work harness, tiny rivet pouch, talon bands, and signal-panel repair props clipped to body.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Medium bird with tall red crest, chisel beak, stiff tail, and braced pecking posture.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons with beak prominent and tools clipped, not hand-held.

reserveEnemies.name: Cormorant Netter
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Environmental snares from dock lines and fishing debris.
reserveEnemies.description: A wet-winged canal netter that turns loose dock line into dragged, physical control.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Cormorant in a slate rain shell, oar-strap harness, dock-line loops clipped to body, and orange webbed-foot bands.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Long-neck black waterbird with hooked beak, folded wet wings, and webbed-foot stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on webbed feet with lines clipped to harness, never held by invented hands.

reserveEnemies.name: Moth Lantern-Drifter
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Light-reflection movement and targeting distraction.
reserveEnemies.description: A night moth that drifts around service lamps and draws attention away from harder threats.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Large moth with tiny body-safe reflective tags and no wing coverings near a practical lantern and rain-specked utility glass.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Soft wide-wing insect with small body, feathery antennae, and flutter-ready stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, single readable moth grounded or resting low, wings natural and unobstructed.

reserveEnemies.name: Hermit Crab Salvager
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Changes cover shell using urban debris.
reserveEnemies.description: A dock salvager that swaps found shell cover and changes how the flock wants to attack it.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Hermit crab using a natural shell decorated with tiny salvage stickers, cargo strap, and small waterproof pouch; legs and claws fully free.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Tiny crab body emerging from rounded shell, one larger claw, low scuttling base.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on natural legs with shell readable as shelter, not armor plating.

reserveEnemies.name: Caterpillar Roadcrew
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Sticky trail lines that reshape movement lanes.
reserveEnemies.description: A slow roadcrew caterpillar that leaves tacky lines across service paths and forces awkward routing.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Large caterpillar with tiny high-visibility strap bands, no limb restriction, and utility-cone color accents on wet pavement.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Segmented low body with many tiny legs, rounded head, and slow lane-blocking shape.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, fully grounded across natural body length with straps following segments.

reserveEnemies.name: Tarantula Corner-Keeper
reserveEnemies.varietyContribution: Corner traps and trip hazards in alleys and crate stacks.
reserveEnemies.description: A heavy spider that owns tight corners with trip lines, patience, and unsettling stillness.
reserveEnemies.visualBrief: Tarantula with tiny strap accents, reflective leg tags, and no covered legs among alley crates and fence corners with physical silk lines.
reserveEnemies.silhouette: Low broad spider with eight natural legs, heavy abdomen, and still trap-setting stance.
reserveEnemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, all eight legs grounded and visible, no humanoid posture or clothing mass.
